title: Activated sludge from a heterotrophic-autotrophic coupled system for the treatment of landfill leachate
description: The substantial production of high-nitrogen landfill leachate inevitably leads to excessive resource consumption during its treatment, necessitating the urgent development of feasible low-carbon nitrogen removal processes. This study developed a heterotrophic-autotrophic (H-A) coupled biological treatment system composed of an anaerobic-anoxic-oxic (A2O) process, an anaerobic membrane bioreactor (AnMBR), and a sulfur-driven autotrophic denitrification filter (SADF) for nitrogen removal from actual landfill leachate.
